nuggets.text: Wildcats receiver Noah Kjar plays for his dad, first-year Weber State head coach Eric Kjar.
Wildcats receiver Noah Kjar leads the Big Sky with 264 receiving yards and four touchdown catches.
Wildcats coach Eric Kjar coached Zach Wilson and Jaxson Dart in high school; both became first-round NFL draft picks.
Wildcats coach Eric Kjar jumped straight from high school to a Division I head job, a hire that rarely happens.
Wildcats coach Eric Kjar played college ball for another set of Wildcats, Wayne State in Nebraska, first at QB and then receiver.
Wildcats coach Eric Kjar's Corner Canyon High teams won a Utah state-record 48 straight games from 2018 to 2021.
Wildcats freshman Zach Smith, back from a mission in May, blocked a PAT with 3 seconds left to win 30-29 at Northern Colorado.
Wildcats linebacker Zach Smith returned an interception 91 yards at Southern Utah, the third-longest pick return in program history.
The Wildcats and Buffaloes have never played; Saturday in Boulder is their first-ever meeting.
The Wildcats retired Jamie Martin's No. 10; he won the 1991 Walter Payton Award after leading Division I-AA in passing.
